settings.name: USE_GREYLIST
settings.description: **Enable Greylist:** Set to `yes` to enable greylisting.

settings.name: GREYLIST_IP
settings.description: **IP Greylist:** List of IP addresses or networks (in CIDR notation) to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_IP_URLS
settings.description: **IP Greylist URLs:** List of URLs containing IP addresses or networks to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_RDNS
settings.description: **rDNS Greylist:** List of reverse DNS suffixes to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_RDNS_GLOBAL
settings.description: **rDNS Global Only:** Only perform rDNS greylist checks on global IP addresses when set to `yes`.

settings.name: GREYLIST_RDNS_URLS
settings.description: **rDNS Greylist URLs:** List of URLs containing reverse DNS suffixes to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_ASN
settings.description: **ASN Greylist:** List of Autonomous System Numbers to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_ASN_URLS
settings.description: **ASN Greylist URLs:** List of URLs containing ASNs to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **User-Agent Greylist:** List of User-Agent patterns (PCRE regex) to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_USER_AGENT_URLS
settings.description: **User-Agent Greylist URLs:** List of URLs containing User-Agent patterns to greylist.

settings.name: GREYLIST_URI
settings.description: **URI Greylist:** List of URI patterns (PCRE regex) to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_URI_URLS
settings.description: **URI Greylist URLs:** List of URLs containing URI patterns to greylist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: GREYLIST_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request be greylisted. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: GREYLIST_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.
